parameters.fetchXml:
<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="true">
  <entity name="new_purchaseorder">
    <attribute name="new_purchaseorderid" />
    <attribute name="new_name" />
    <attribute name="new_ponumber" />
    <order attribute="new_ponumber" descending="false" />
    <link-entity name="new_timesheet" from="new_purchaseorderid" to="new_purchaseorderid" link-type="inner" alias="ab">
      <filter type="and">
        <condition attribute="new_invoiceid" operator="eq" uitype="new_invoice" value="@{body('Get_an_Invoice_row_by_ID')?['new_invoiceid']}" />
      </filter>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>

<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="true">
  <entity name="contact">
    <attribute name="fullname" />
    <attribute name="contactid" />
    <order attribute="fullname" descending="false" />
    <link-entity name="new_timesheet" from="new_candidateid" to="contactid" link-type="inner" alias="ac">
      <filter type="and">
        <condition attribute="new_invoiceid" operator="eq" uitype="new_invoice" value="@{body('Get_an_Invoice_row_by_ID')?['new_invoiceid']}" />
      </filter>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>

<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="false">
  <entity name="new_invoicedetail">
     <attribute name="new_assignmentid" />
    <attribute name="new_assignmentrateid" />
    <attribute name="new_date" />
    <attribute name="new_units" />
   <attribute name="new_bill" />
  <attribute name="new_tax" />
  <attribute name="new_total" />
    <attribute name="new_billtotal" />
    <attribute name="new_billtaxtypeid" />
    <order attribute="new_date" descending="false" />
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="new_invoiceid" operator="eq" uitype="new_invoice" value="@{triggerOutputs()?['body/new_invoiceid']}" />
   <condition attribute="new_units" operator="gt" value="0" />
  
    </filter>
  </entity>
</fetch>
